info.title: 星屿云 Finance API
info.description: Same-origin JSON API. Success bodies are `{ "data": ... }`, failures `{ "error": { code, message, request_id } }`. Writes need `X-CSRF-Token`; operations marked x-idempotent need an `Idempotency-Key` and replay the first result. Money is integer minor units. Staff endpoints check `x-permission` on every request.
